messages.text: What can I do to get a refund if I no longer need the set?

Once the order is delivered, you can return the set; the shop must record that it has received it back before a refund can be requested. The refund request must be made within 30 days of the recorded delivery time (refund-policy/v2/return; refund-policy/v2/window). Since the order is still marked as shipped, a refund isn’t available through this process yet (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). You can also ask me to connect you with a staff member about cancelling or changing delivery.
